message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | # | Rule | Details | |---|------|---------| | 1 | **Objective** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by winning rounds and are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | 2 | **Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down to form the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | 3 | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). | | 4 | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either:
• the **color** of the top discard card, or
• the **number**/symbol of the top discard card.
• A **wild** card can be played at any time. | | 5 | **Action Cards** | • **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Skip (+S)** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse (+R)** – Reverses play direction.
• **Wild (+W)** – You choose the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+WD4)** – You choose the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | 6 | **Drawing a Card** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise your turn ends. | | 7 | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, you must say “UNO.” If you forget and another player calls you out before the next player takes a turn, you must draw two penalty cards. | | 8 | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Draw Two, Skip, Reverse = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | 9 | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. If the winner reaches or exceeds the target score (e.g., 500), the game ends and they are declared the overall winner. | |10 | **Replenishing the Draw Pile** | If the draw pile runs out, shuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to create a new draw pile. | |11 | **House Rules** | Many groups add variations (e.g., “Stacking” where +2 cards can be stacked, “Seven‑Zero” where 7 reverses direction and 0 swaps hands). Clarify any house rules before starting. | --- ### Quick Play Summary 1. **Deal** 7 cards each. 2. **Start** with the top card of the draw pile. 3. **Play** a matching card or draw if you can’t. 4. **Use** action cards to affect opponents. 5. **Call UNO** when you’re down to one card. 6. **Finish** the round when someone goes out. 7. **Score** and continue until someone hits the target. Enjoy your game of Uno!
